The proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients receiving an echocardiography is a key quality indicator in cardiology, with a national standard requiring at least 80% compliance [^src1]. An analysis of regional performance reveals significant disparities in adherence to this standard across Denmark [^src1]. 

[[region-midtjylland|Midtjylland]] stands out as the clear leader and the only region to successfully meet the ≥80% target, achieving a compliance rate of 84.5% in the current year [^src1]. In stark contrast, [[region-hovedstaden|Hovedstaden]] is the trailer, recording the lowest national performance at just 59.9%, falling significantly short of the standard [^src1]. The remaining regions—[[region-sjaelland|Sjælland]] (70.0%), [[region-nordjylland|Nordjylland]] (72.4%), and [[region-syddanmark|Syddanmark]] (75.3%)—also failed to meet the threshold, resulting in the national average missing the target at 71.9% [^src1]. 

Despite the widespread failure to meet the current standard, historical data indicates a general upward trend in echocardiography compliance over time across most regions [^src1]. For instance, the national average improved from 67.8% in the earliest recorded period to 71.9% currently [^src1]. [[region-hovedstaden|Hovedstaden]] showed steady growth from 53.2% to 59.9%, while [[region-nordjylland|Nordjylland]] increased from 69.9% to 72.4% [^src1]. However, this upward trajectory is not entirely uniform; [[region-syddanmark|Syddanmark]] experienced a slight recent decline from 77.3% to 75.3%, and [[region-midtjylland|Midtjylland]] saw a marginal dip from 84.8% to 84.5%, though the latter remained safely above the target [^src1]. Ultimately, while incremental progress is evident, substantial efforts are required in all regions except [[region-midtjylland|Midtjylland]] to bridge the gap to the 80% quality standard [^src1].

- "Region Sjælland vurderer, at resultaterne for indikator 8 ikke stemmer overens med den kliniske virkelighed" — see [[critical-assessment|Critical Assessment]] ([[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland — Sjælland]]) [^src25]
- "Region Sjælland har iværksat en intern undersøgelse af registrerings- og dataflow-fejl i forbindelse med indikator 8" — see [[quality-improvement-action|Quality Improvement Action]] ([[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland — Sjælland]]) [^src25]
